_note: The brands with client-approved case-study artwork in public/assets/work2/. Name, group and service tags are NOT stored here: they come from work-clients.json (by id) through src/lib/work.ts, so they cannot drift. `scope` and `shows` describe only what is visibly built in the artwork, never an outcome; `{name}` in scope is replaced with the brand's display name. The word 'mockup' is not used: the authenticity line is ARTWORK_LINE in src/lib/site.ts.
_proofSlots: Optional slots, all EMPTY today and rendered only when filled with real, checkable data. Never invent. timeframe: string, e.g. 'First 90 days' (the period the figures cover). basis: string, what the figures are based on (spend band, sample, attribution). whatWeDid: a written note that replaces the sentence built from the service tags. metrics: [{label, value, basis}] each with its own basis. team: [{name, role}] named MMC people on the account. testimonial: {quote, name, role} with a quote the client has approved.
